title: 日本ダービーの後に・Die Faszination

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …I placed. What a fine result.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: But, I—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash was really impressive.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: You can say that again… She was so cool, I couldn't take my eyes off her…

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Lady Flash…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: They're all looking at me…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Um…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Everyone… I thank you for your support.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I will show you a winning performance next time! I promise!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My apologies. I am still terribly worked up from the race… I should be able to regain my composure momentarily.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It was… The crowd and other racers were more excited than usual.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It's making it hard for me to contain my emotions… This is so unsightly of me…
choice_data_list: It's normal to feel frustrated after losing.
It's normal to feel frustrated after losing.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: But if I don't contain myself, I'll become even greedier…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: If I do not pull myself together…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I fear I will never be satisfied with anything other than victory.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Is that really so? Placing is remarkable enough in itself though.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That's why placing within the top three has always been my goal. But now…
choice_data_list: Let's win the next one, Flash!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Let's!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Let's begin planning for my next race at once.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: We must prepare for the final race of the Classic Triple Crown—the Kikuka Sho.
choice_data_list: Let's head back to the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The moment we step inside the waiting room, Eishin Flash receives a message from her parents.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "We can tell how hard you have been working. It's fantastic that you were able to place in the top three."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "It proves how strong you've become. You must feel incredibly frustrated that you couldn't get first."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …"We wish we could give you a hug and cheer you on in person right now."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "We hope the joy of your future victories will keep you buoyed and fulfilled."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: They do… Since they have no plans to visit Japan during these three years…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The least I can do is report as many victories to them as possible.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I have accomplished all I sought to according to my timetable. Let's keep up the momentum and continue on.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: But before that, there is something I would like to report to you. I'm sure it is nothing serious, but…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I can't accept this. Why are you removing the Kikuka Sho from my schedule?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Eishin Flash informed me that her leg felt strange, so I took her to see a doctor. There, we found out it's because her muscles are overfatigued.
choice_data_list: The pain will only get worse if you don't rest.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: But there is more than enough time for me to fully recover before the Kikuka Sho.
choice_data_list: If it looks like you'll be ready by then, then we'll enter.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I cannot follow your logic. Doesn't it make more sense to set the goal first so we can base our plan around it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho is such a grueling race that it's said only top racers can win. If she insists on running it, she will only become more fatigued.
choice_data_list: Your goal is to see every race through to the end, isn't it?
Your goal is to see every race through to the end, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Promise me that you'll adjust your schedule when I deem it necessary.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Promise me that you'll adjust your schedule when I deem it necessary.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Promises are… eternally binding…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …Very well. Let's remove the Kikuka Sho from my schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The most important thing is that I complete every race…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …I'm fine. Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My perfect schedule…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I should ask my parents—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: No, I cannot discuss this with them. They must never know that this failure was due to my own mismanagement…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …And that I wasn't good enough.
